panels.title: Active Pagers
panels.description: Unique capcodes seen in the last hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniq(capcode) AS count FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: Pages / min
panels.description: Pages per minute over the last 5 minutes

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() / 5 AS pages_per_min FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT count() AS total FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp > today()
SELECT uniq(capcode) AS count FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp > today()
SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time, count() AS pages FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Protocol Split
panels.description: Pages by baud rate in the last hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT protocol, count() AS pages FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY protocol ORDER BY pages DESC

panels.title: Message Types
panels.description: Alpha vs numeric vs tone-only pages in the last hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT msg_type, count() AS pages FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY msg_type ORDER BY pages DESC

panels.title: Top Pagers (last hour)
panels.description: Busiest capcodes and their latest message

targets.rawSql: SELECT capcode, count() AS pages, anyLast(msg_type) AS last_type, argMax(message, timestamp) AS last_message, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM pocsag.messages WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY capcode ORDER BY pages DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Recent Pages
panels.description: Last 50 decoded pages. This shows message text and is for local viewing only; do not screenshot or share it (see pocsag/README.md).

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, protocol, capcode, function, msg_type, message FROM pocsag.messages ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
